title: Corporate Trainer – Soft Skills (f/m/d)
description:
Deliver communication and collaboration workshops for corporate clients.

What you'll do
- Facilitate one- and two-day workshops for groups of 8 to 20
- Adapt curricula to client needs and collect feedback
- Support client HR teams with follow-up

What you bring
- 3+ years as trainer or facilitator in a corporate setting
- Experience with adult-learning methods and virtual classrooms
- Excellent English; workshops are held in English
